WHERE query_id = '01c77799-0208-bb91-0011-5b5200022262' /* dbt-cost-tuning */

WITH h AS (
  SELECT * FROM TABLE(TASTY_BYTES_DBT_DB.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.QUERY_HISTORY_BY_USER(
         USER_NAME            => '"<REDACTED>"',
         END_TIME_RANGE_START => '2026-10-02 12:19:05.084 -0700'::TIMESTAMP_LTZ,
         END_TIME_RANGE_END   => DATEADD(second, 1, '2026-10-02 12:22:42.397 -0700'::TIMESTAMP_LTZ),
         RESULT_LIMIT => 10000))
),
c AS (
  SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(query_text, '"node_id": "([^"]+)"', 1, 1, 'e') AS node_id,
         IFF(REGEXP_SUBSTR(query_text, '"node_id": "([^"]+)"', 1, 1, 'e') IS NULL AND query_type IN ('CREATE_TABLE_AS_SELECT','INSERT','MERGE'),
             LOWER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(query_text, 'TABLE\\s+(IF\\s+NOT\\s+EXISTS\\s+)?([A-Za-z0-9_."]+)', 1, 1, 'ie', 2)),
             NULL) AS target_relation,
         query_id, query_type, warehouse_size, execution_time, total_elapsed_time, bytes_scanned, rows_inserted
  FROM h
  WHERE query_id <> '01c77787-0208-c3ea-0011-5b520001f266'
    AND start_time >= '2026-10-02 12:19:05.084 -0700'::TIMESTAMP_LTZ
    AND query_type NOT IN ('USE','SHOW','DESCRIBE')
    AND query_text NOT ILIKE 'SELECT CURRENT\\_%'
)
SELECT COALESCE(node_id, 'unattributed:' || COALESCE(target_relation, query_type)) AS node,
       COUNT(*) AS queries,
       ROUND(SUM(execution_time / 3600000.0 * DECODE(warehouse_size,'X-Small',1,'Small',2,'Medium',4,'Large',8,'X-Large',16,'2X-Large',32,'3X-Large',64,'4X-Large',128,'5X-Large',256,'6X-Large',512, 0)), 5) AS credits,
       ROUND(AVG(total_elapsed_time) / 1000, 1) AS avg_secs,
       MAX(rows_inserted) AS rows_written,
       SUM(bytes_scanned) AS total_bytes_scanned
FROM c
WHERE node_id IS NOT NULL OR target_relation IN ('tasty_bytes_dbt_db.dev.sales_metrics_by_location')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY credits DESC /* dbt-cost-tuning */
